<Ui>
    <!--
        The ESC menu: the stock GameMenuFrame.xml, reshaped in place as a 1.12 addon reshapes it.
        Deviation: the rungs are the 1.15 era client's ESC menu, because its settings screens
        replace 1.12's, which are much worse to use; the era's AddOns rung is dropped, since the
        character-select AddOns screen is the only addon UI.
    -->

    <!-- The era's header font, which 1.12's Fonts.xml lacks. -->
    <Font name="BenillaGameFontNormalMed1" inherits="GameFontNormal" virtual="true">
        <FontHeight><AbsValue val="13"/></FontHeight>
    </Font>

    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- ══ The frame: the era layout, 28+144+28 wide, 32 top, 28 bottom, 7 rungs of 21 and
        -- three gaps of 20 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        GameMenuFrame:SetWidth(200)
        GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(267)

        -- The stock title (`GameMenuFrame.xml:36`) has no name: found as addons find it.
        for _, region in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetRegions() }) do
            if region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" and region:GetText() == MAIN_MENU then
                region:SetFontObject(BenillaGameFontNormalMed1)
            end
        end

        -- BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE (OptionsFrame.xml) stands in for the era's UIParent scale;
        -- read at every show, then the stock OnShow.
        local Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow")
        GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function()
            this:SetScale(BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE or 1)
            Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow()
        end)

        -- ══ The rungs ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        -- Every stock rung stays, anchored TOP to a BOTTOM as in the stock file, so an addon's
        -- `SetPoint("TOP", …)` replaces its one anchor. The three the era menu lacks are hidden
        -- in place, with Sound and UI Options each laid over the rung above it, so they take no
        -- space: a width or height of 0 is no size in 1.12's layout, not a flat rect.

        -- Literal: 1.12 has no GAMEMENU_OPTIONS; its OPTIONS_MENU is "Options Menu".
        GameMenuButtonOptions:SetText("Options")
        GameMenuButtonOptions:ClearAllPoints()
        GameMenuButtonOptions:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32)
        GameMenuButtonOptions:SetScript("OnClick", function()
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOption")
            HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame)
            ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame)
        end)

        for _, fold in ipairs({
            { GameMenuButtonSoundOptions, GameMenuButtonOptions },
            { GameMenuButtonUIOptions, GameMenuButtonSoundOptions },
        }) do
            local button, above = fold[1], fold[2]
            button:Hide()
            button:ClearAllPoints()
            button:SetPoint("TOP", above, "BOTTOM", 0, button:GetHeight())
        end
        -- Key Bindings keeps its stock anchor, 1 under UI Options: the era rungs hang from its
        -- top, so an addon that inserts a button above it and re-anchors it under that button
        -- (ShaguTweaks) moves them down as it moves the stock rungs.
        GameMenuButtonKeybindings:Hide()

        -- The era's Edit Mode and Support, with nothing behind them yet: disabled.
        local editMode = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonEditMode", GameMenuFrame,
            "GameMenuButtonTemplate")
        editMode:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonKeybindings, "TOP", 0, -19)
        editMode:SetText("Edit Mode")
        editMode:Disable()
        local support = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSupport", GameMenuFrame,
            "GameMenuButtonTemplate")
        support:SetPoint("TOP", editMode, "BOTTOM", 0, 0)
        support:SetText("Support")
        support:Disable()

        GameMenuButtonMacros:SetPoint("TOP", support, "BOTTOM", 0, 0)
        GameMenuButtonLogout:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonMacros, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)
        GameMenuButtonQuit:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonLogout, "BOTTOM", 0, 0)
        GameMenuButtonContinue:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonQuit, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)

        -- ══ Our options window in the stock "is an options window open?" checks ═══════════════
        -- Each wraps the stock function to add `BenillaOptionsFrame`.
        local Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen = IsOptionFrameOpen
        local Ref_ToggleGameMenu = ToggleGameMenu
        local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons

        -- Guarded for a test kit that loads the game menu without the options window.
        local function BenillaOptions_IsOpen()
            return BenillaOptionsFrame and BenillaOptionsFrame:IsVisible()
        end

        -- `UIParent.lua:996`: a yes keeps the ESC sweep off the centre panel, which our window is.
        function IsOptionFrameOpen()
            if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then
                return 1
            end
            return Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen()
        end

        -- `UIParent.lua:1465-1497`: static popup, then an open options window, then the stock
        -- ladder. Our Close click is the discard-and-hide of the reference's `OptionsFrameCancel`.
        function ToggleGameMenu(clicked)
            if clicked then
                -- As the reference's `clicked` arm: close an options window, then toggle.
                if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then
                    BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click()
                end
                return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked)
            end
            if StaticPopup_EscapePressed() then
                return
            end
            if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then
                BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click()
                return
            end
            return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked)
        end

        -- `MainMenuBarMicroButtons.lua:47-58`: only ever pushes the button, so the stock decision
        -- stands and ours adds our window. Guarded for a test kit that loads no micro buttons.
        function UpdateMicroButtons()
            if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then
                Ref_UpdateMicroButtons()
            end
            if MainMenuMicroButton and BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then
                MainMenuMicroButton:SetButtonState("PUSHED", 1)
            end
        end
    ]]></Script>
</Ui>

<Ui>
    <!--
        The options window's Keybindings page: templates and script; its rows live in
        OptionsFrame.xml, which loads after. Only commands the engine dispatches appear.
        Deviation: the layout is the era Settings panel's Keybindings page (collapsible category
        sections), because 1.12's settings screens are much worse to use. Capture follows 1.12's
        Blizzard_BindingUI: while a capsule is selected the window is keyboard-enabled, so the
        next key binds through its OnKeyDown, and a mouse 3/4/5 click or a wheel notch binds;
        left and right clicks only select, and ESC while armed binds Escape (its OnKeyDown has no
        ESCAPE filter).
        Deviation: every bind, unbind and reset saves at once, as the era panel commits, where
        1.12 had Okay and Cancel; only Reset To Default and leaving the character set confirm.
    -->

    <!-- 1.12's KeyBindingFrameBindingButtonTemplate; all five buttons reach the handler. -->
    <Button name="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" virtual="true">
        <Size><AbsDimension x="180" y="22"/></Size>
        <ButtonText name="$parentText"/>
        <NormalTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Up"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></NormalTexture>
        <PushedTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Down"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></PushedTexture>
        <HighlightTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Highlight" alphaMode="ADD"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></HighlightTexture>
        <NormalFont inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
        <HighlightFont inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
        <DisabledFont inherits="GameFontDisableSmall"/>
        <Scripts>
            <OnLoad>this:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp", "MiddleButtonUp", "Button4Up", "Button5Up")</OnLoad>
            <OnClick>BenillaKeyBindingButton_OnClick(arg1)</OnClick>
        </Scripts>
    </Button>

    <!-- A binding row or a section header in 1.12's QuestLogTitleButton dress, since the era's
         expand arrows are not in 1.12; 25 tall, the era's row height. -->
    <Frame name="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" virtual="true">
        <Size><AbsDimension x="560" y="25"/></Size>
        <Layers>
            <Layer level="BACKGROUND">
                <FontString name="$parentDescription" inherits="GameFontNormalSmall" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Size><AbsDimension x="170" y="24"/></Size>
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"/></Anchors>
                </FontString>
            </Layer>
        </Layers>
        <Frames>
            <Button name="$parentHeader" hidden="true">
                <Anchors>
                    <Anchor point="TOPLEFT"/>
                    <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"/>
                </Anchors>
                <Layers>
                    <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                        <Texture name="$parentIcon">
                            <Size><AbsDimension x="16" y="16"/></Size>
                            <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="2" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                        </Texture>
                    </Layer>
                </Layers>
                <ButtonText name="$parentText" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Anchors>
                        <Anchor point="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="24" y="1"/></Offset></Anchor>
                        <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="1"/></Offset></Anchor>
                    </Anchors>
                </ButtonText>
                <NormalFont inherits="GameFontNormal"/>
                <HighlightFont inherits="GameFontHighlight"/>
                <Scripts>
                    <OnClick>BenillaKeyBindings_ToggleSection(this.sectionIndex)</OnClick>
                </Scripts>
            </Button>
            <Button name="$parentKey1Button" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" id="1">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="175" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>
            <Button name="$parentKey2Button" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" id="2">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT" relativeTo="$parentKey1Button" relativePoint="RIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>
        </Frames>
    </Frame>

    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- ── Strings ── a 1.12 GlobalStrings global, or the fallback for a harness without them.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_String(name, fallback)
            local s = getglobal(name)
            if s then return s end
            return fallback
        end

        -- ── Key display ── 1.12's GetBindingText in full form: modifier prefixes stay tokens, the
        -- base key reads its KEY_* global. "CTRL--" is CTRL plus the minus key.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key)
            if not key then
                return NORMAL_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("NOT_BOUND", "Not Bound") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE
            end
            local prefix = ""
            local rest = key
            while true do
                local p = string.sub(rest, 1, 4)
                if p == "ALT-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "ALT-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 5)
                elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 5) == "CTRL-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "CTRL-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 6)
                elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 6) == "SHIFT-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "SHIFT-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 7)
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            return prefix .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_" .. rest, rest)
        end

        -- ── Page state ── `searchPainted` maps OptionsFrame.xml's search rows to binding indices.
        BenillaKeyBindingsPage = { sections = {}, items = {} }

        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsRow"
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED = 19
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT = 25
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS = 8

        -- ── Section model ── one section per `HEADER_*` row of the binding list, in its
        -- order (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:84-92), collapsed at first as in the era; a rebuild keeps
        -- each state. `token` is the header's GlobalStrings key, `fallback` its bare name.
        -- Deviation: the spacer headers BLANK, BLANK2 and BLANK3 over multibars 2-4
        -- (Bindings.xml:883/967/1051), which 1.12 draws blank (BINDING_HEADER_BLANK is "  ", the
        -- other two are not defined), continue the section above, because this page's sections
        -- are named and collapsible.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command)
            return strsub(command, 1, 6) == "HEADER"
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local was = {}
            for _, s in ipairs(page.sections) do
                was[s.token] = s.expanded
            end
            page.sections = {}
            local sec = nil
            for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do
                local command = GetBinding(i)
                if BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then
                    local token = "BINDING_" .. command
                    if not (sec and strfind(command, "^HEADER_BLANK%d*$")) then
                        sec = { token = token, fallback = strsub(command, 8), indices = {},
                            expanded = was[token] }
                        table.insert(page.sections, sec)
                    end
                elseif sec then
                    table.insert(sec.indices, i)
                end
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
        end

        -- The visible list the faux scroll runs over.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            page.items = {}
            for n, sec in ipairs(page.sections) do
                table.insert(page.items, { header = n })
                if sec.expanded then
                    for _, i in ipairs(sec.indices) do
                        table.insert(page.items, { bind = i })
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- A header click, voiced with the checkbox sound.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_ToggleSection(n)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            if not sec then return end
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            sec.expanded = not sec.expanded
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
        end

        -- Silent, for the capture fixture.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_ExpandSection(n, on)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            if not sec then return end
            sec.expanded = on and true or false
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
        end

        -- ── Painters ── shared by the list and the search rows, which capture in place.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index)
            local command, key1, key2 = GetBinding(index)
            local b1 = getglobal(name .. "Key1Button")
            local b2 = getglobal(name .. "Key2Button")
            b1.commandName = command
            b2.commandName = command
            b1:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key1))
            b2:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key2))
            if key1 then b1:SetAlpha(1) else b1:SetAlpha(0.8) end
            if key2 then b2:SetAlpha(1) else b2:SetAlpha(0.8) end
            local desc = getglobal(name .. "Description")
            desc:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command))
            desc:Show()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 1 then
                b1:LockHighlight()
            else
                b1:UnlockHighlight()
            end
            if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 2 then
                b2:LockHighlight()
            else
                b2:UnlockHighlight()
            end
            b1:Show()
            b2:Show()
            getglobal(name .. "Header"):Hide()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, n)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            local header = getglobal(name .. "Header")
            header.sectionIndex = n
            header:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String(sec.token, sec.fallback))
            local icon = getglobal(name .. "HeaderIcon")
            if sec.expanded then
                icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up")
            else
                icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up")
            end
            header:Show()
            getglobal(name .. "Description"):Hide()
            getglobal(name .. "Key1Button"):Hide()
            getglobal(name .. "Key2Button"):Hide()
        end

        -- ── The list repaint (1.12 KeyBindingFrame_Update) ──
        function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local scroll = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrame")
            local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll)
            for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED do
                local name = BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE .. i
                local row = getglobal(name)
                local item = page.items[offset + i]
                if item and item.header then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, item.header)
                    row:Show()
                elseif item then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, item.bind)
                    row:Show()
                else
                    row:Hide()
                end
            end
            FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(page.items),
                BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT)
            -- Our trough follows the bar `FauxScrollFrame_Update` has just shown or hidden.
            BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName())
            BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
        end

        -- The page entry: a rebind or a set switch may have changed the table.
        function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections()
            local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsCharacterRowCheck")
            if GetCurrentBindingSet() == 2 then
                box:SetChecked(1)
            else
                box:SetChecked(nil)
            end
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrameScrollBar"):SetValue(0)
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_Output(text)
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsOutput"):SetText(text)
        end

        -- ── Selection ── while a capsule is selected the window takes every key and the
        -- wheel, as 1.12's keyboard-enabled KeyBindingFrame does (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:73,
        -- :541-543); unarmed it takes neither, so keys and the wheel reach the game.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(command, keyID)
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected = command
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.keyID = keyID
            if BenillaOptionsFrame then
                BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableKeyboard(command ~= nil)
                BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableMouseWheel(command ~= nil)
            end
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
            local unbind = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind")
            if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected then
                unbind:Enable()
            else
                unbind:Disable()
            end
        end

        -- Every search row: a bind from one can unbind a victim shown on another.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
            if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted then
                for name, index in pairs(BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted) do
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index)
                end
                BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
            else
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
            end
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingButton_OnClick (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:228-258): while armed, a middle,
        -- 4 or 5 click binds that button.
        function BenillaKeyBindingButton_OnClick(button)
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if page.selected then
                if button ~= "LeftButton" and button ~= "RightButton" then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button)
                    return
                end
                if page.selected == this.commandName and page.keyID == this:GetID() then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                else
                    BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID())
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"),
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName)))
                end
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID())
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                    BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"),
                    BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName)))
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            SaveBindings(GetCurrentBindingSet())
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_OnKeyDown armed branch (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:140-212), then
        -- the live commit: `button` is a mouse button's or the wheel's name, else the key is
        -- `arg1`, the window's OnKeyDown argument. Unarmed it does nothing: the window takes keys
        -- only while armed, so 1.12's unarmed ESCAPE arm never runs here.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button)
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if not page.selected then
                return
            end
            if button == "LeftButton" then
                button = "BUTTON1"
            elseif button == "RightButton" then
                button = "BUTTON2"
            elseif button == "MiddleButton" then
                button = "BUTTON3"
            elseif button == "Button4" then
                button = "BUTTON4"
            elseif button == "Button5" then
                button = "BUTTON5"
            end
            local chord
            if button then
                if button == "BUTTON1" or button == "BUTTON2" then
                    return
                end
                chord = button
            else
                chord = arg1
            end
            if chord == "UNKNOWN" or chord == "SHIFT" or chord == "CTRL" or chord == "ALT" then
                return
            end
            if IsShiftKeyDown() then chord = "SHIFT-" .. chord end
            if IsControlKeyDown() then chord = "CTRL-" .. chord end
            if IsAltKeyDown() then chord = "ALT-" .. chord end
            local selected = page.selected
            local oldAction = GetBindingAction(chord)
            if oldAction ~= "" and oldAction ~= selected then
                local k1, k2 = GetBindingKey(oldAction)
                if (not k1 or k1 == chord) and (not k2 or k2 == chord) then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR", "|cffff0000%s Function is Now Unbound!|r"),
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. oldAction, oldAction)))
                else
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "Key Bound Successfully"))
                end
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "Key Bound Successfully"))
            end
            local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(selected)
            if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end
            if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end
            if page.keyID == 1 then
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key1)
                if key2 then SetBinding(key2, selected) end
            else
                if key1 then SetBinding(key1, selected) end
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key2)
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_SetBinding, message and all; SetBinding refuses only a non-key.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(key, command, oldKey)
            if not SetBinding(key, command) then
                if oldKey then SetBinding(oldKey, command) end
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String(
                    "KEYBINDINGFRAME_MOUSEWHEEL_ERROR",
                    "Can't bind mousewheel to actions with up and down states"))
            end
        end

        -- The list's OnMouseWheel while armed (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:377-387).
        function BenillaKeyBindings_OnMouseWheel(delta)
            if delta > 0 then
                BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELUP")
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELDOWN")
            end
        end

        -- 1.12's Unbind Key body, then the live commit.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_Unbind()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(page.selected)
            if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end
            if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end
            if key1 and page.keyID == 1 then
                if key2 then SetBinding(key2, page.selected) end
            else
                if key1 then SetBinding(key1, page.selected) end
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
            BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        -- ── Character-specific set ── checking saves set 2 at once (LoadBindings(2) falls back
        -- to the account set); unchecking confirms first, as the era does. The accept loads set 1
        -- before saving it, or the character binds would be written into the account set.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_CharacterToggle(box)
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            if box:GetChecked() then
                LoadBindings(2)
                SaveBindings(2)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            else
                box:SetChecked(1)
                StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS")
            end
        end

        -- Our key: Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:10 defines the stock one for its own window.
        StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS"] = {
            text = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS",
                "Really switch to general key bindings?  All key bindings specific to this character will be permanantly deleted."),
            button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"),
            button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"),
            OnAccept = function()
                LoadBindings(1)
                SaveBindings(1)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            end,
        }
        -- Reset To Default confirms, as the era's does; our string, since 1.12 has none.
        StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_RESET_KEYBINDINGS"] = {
            text = "Are you sure you want to reset all keybindings to their defaults?",
            button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"),
            button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"),
            OnAccept = function()
                PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
                LoadBindings(0)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            end,
        }

        -- ── Search ── a binding's tag is its display name uppercased, as the era's.
        -- A static pool of BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS rows, where the era's results scroll.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SearchMatches(words)
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do
                local command = GetBinding(i)
                if not BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then
                    local tag = string.upper(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command))
                    local s = BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(tag, words)
                    if s then
                        table.insert(out, { score = s, index = i })
                    end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
    ]]></Script>
</Ui>

<Ui>
    <!--
        The options window's Keybindings page: templates and script; its rows live in
        OptionsFrame.xml, which loads after. Only commands the engine dispatches appear.
        Deviation: the layout is the era Settings panel's Keybindings page (collapsible category
        sections), because 1.12's settings screens are much worse to use. Capture follows 1.12's
        Blizzard_BindingUI: while a capsule is selected the window is keyboard-enabled, so the
        next key binds through its OnKeyDown, and a mouse 3/4/5 click or a wheel notch binds;
        left and right clicks only select, and ESC while armed binds Escape (its OnKeyDown has no
        ESCAPE filter).
        Deviation: every bind, unbind and reset saves at once, as the era panel commits, where
        1.12 had Okay and Cancel; only Reset To Default and leaving the character set confirm.
    -->

    <!-- 1.12's KeyBindingFrameBindingButtonTemplate; all five buttons reach the handler. -->
    <Button name="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" virtual="true">
        <Size><AbsDimension x="180" y="22"/></Size>
        <ButtonText name="$parentText"/>
        <NormalTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Up"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></NormalTexture>
        <PushedTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Down"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></PushedTexture>
        <HighlightTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-Button-Highlight" alphaMode="ADD"><TexCoords left="0" right="0.625" top="0" bottom="0.6875"/></HighlightTexture>
        <NormalFont inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
        <HighlightFont inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
        <DisabledFont inherits="GameFontDisableSmall"/>
        <Scripts>
            <OnLoad>this:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp", "MiddleButtonUp", "Button4Up", "Button5Up")</OnLoad>
            <OnClick>BenillaKeyBindingButton_OnClick(arg1)</OnClick>
        </Scripts>
    </Button>

    <!-- A binding row or a section header in 1.12's QuestLogTitleButton dress, since the era's
         expand arrows are not in 1.12; 25 tall, the era's row height. -->
    <Frame name="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" virtual="true">
        <Size><AbsDimension x="560" y="25"/></Size>
        <Layers>
            <Layer level="BACKGROUND">
                <FontString name="$parentDescription" inherits="GameFontNormalSmall" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Size><AbsDimension x="170" y="24"/></Size>
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"/></Anchors>
                </FontString>
            </Layer>
        </Layers>
        <Frames>
            <Button name="$parentHeader" hidden="true">
                <Anchors>
                    <Anchor point="TOPLEFT"/>
                    <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"/>
                </Anchors>
                <Layers>
                    <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                        <Texture name="$parentIcon">
                            <Size><AbsDimension x="16" y="16"/></Size>
                            <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="2" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                        </Texture>
                    </Layer>
                </Layers>
                <ButtonText name="$parentText" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Anchors>
                        <Anchor point="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="24" y="1"/></Offset></Anchor>
                        <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="1"/></Offset></Anchor>
                    </Anchors>
                </ButtonText>
                <NormalFont inherits="GameFontNormal"/>
                <HighlightFont inherits="GameFontHighlight"/>
                <Scripts>
                    <OnClick>BenillaKeyBindings_ToggleSection(this.sectionIndex)</OnClick>
                </Scripts>
            </Button>
            <Button name="$parentKey1Button" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" id="1">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="175" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>
            <Button name="$parentKey2Button" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingButtonTemplate" id="2">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT" relativeTo="$parentKey1Button" relativePoint="RIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>
        </Frames>
    </Frame>

    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- ── Strings ── a 1.12 GlobalStrings global, or the fallback for a harness without them.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_String(name, fallback)
            local s = getglobal(name)
            if s then return s end
            return fallback
        end

        -- ── Key display ── 1.12's GetBindingText in full form: modifier prefixes stay tokens, the
        -- base key reads its KEY_* global. "CTRL--" is CTRL plus the minus key.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key)
            if not key then
                return NORMAL_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("NOT_BOUND", "지정 안 됨") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE
            end
            local prefix = ""
            local rest = key
            while true do
                local p = string.sub(rest, 1, 4)
                if p == "ALT-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "ALT-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 5)
                elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 5) == "CTRL-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "CTRL-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 6)
                elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 6) == "SHIFT-" then
                    prefix = prefix .. "SHIFT-"
                    rest = string.sub(rest, 7)
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            return prefix .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_" .. rest, rest)
        end

        -- ── Page state ── `searchPainted` maps OptionsFrame.xml's search rows to binding indices.
        BenillaKeyBindingsPage = { sections = {}, items = {} }

        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsRow"
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED = 19
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT = 25
        BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS = 8

        -- ── Section model ── one section per `HEADER_*` row of the binding list, in its
        -- order (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:84-92), collapsed at first as in the era; a rebuild keeps
        -- each state. `token` is the header's GlobalStrings key, `fallback` its bare name.
        -- Deviation: the spacer headers BLANK, BLANK2 and BLANK3 over multibars 2-4
        -- (Bindings.xml:883/967/1051), which 1.12 draws blank (BINDING_HEADER_BLANK is "  ", the
        -- other two are not defined), continue the section above, because this page's sections
        -- are named and collapsible.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command)
            return strsub(command, 1, 6) == "HEADER"
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local was = {}
            for _, s in ipairs(page.sections) do
                was[s.token] = s.expanded
            end
            page.sections = {}
            local sec = nil
            for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do
                local command = GetBinding(i)
                if BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then
                    local token = "BINDING_" .. command
                    if not (sec and strfind(command, "^HEADER_BLANK%d*$")) then
                        sec = { token = token, fallback = strsub(command, 8), indices = {},
                            expanded = was[token] }
                        table.insert(page.sections, sec)
                    end
                elseif sec then
                    table.insert(sec.indices, i)
                end
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
        end

        -- The visible list the faux scroll runs over.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            page.items = {}
            for n, sec in ipairs(page.sections) do
                table.insert(page.items, { header = n })
                if sec.expanded then
                    for _, i in ipairs(sec.indices) do
                        table.insert(page.items, { bind = i })
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- A header click, voiced with the checkbox sound.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_ToggleSection(n)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            if not sec then return end
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            sec.expanded = not sec.expanded
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
        end

        -- Silent, for the capture fixture.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_ExpandSection(n, on)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            if not sec then return end
            sec.expanded = on and true or false
            BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten()
        end

        -- ── Painters ── shared by the list and the search rows, which capture in place.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index)
            local command, key1, key2 = GetBinding(index)
            local b1 = getglobal(name .. "Key1Button")
            local b2 = getglobal(name .. "Key2Button")
            b1.commandName = command
            b2.commandName = command
            b1:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key1))
            b2:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key2))
            if key1 then b1:SetAlpha(1) else b1:SetAlpha(0.8) end
            if key2 then b2:SetAlpha(1) else b2:SetAlpha(0.8) end
            local desc = getglobal(name .. "Description")
            desc:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command))
            desc:Show()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 1 then
                b1:LockHighlight()
            else
                b1:UnlockHighlight()
            end
            if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 2 then
                b2:LockHighlight()
            else
                b2:UnlockHighlight()
            end
            b1:Show()
            b2:Show()
            getglobal(name .. "Header"):Hide()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, n)
            local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n]
            local header = getglobal(name .. "Header")
            header.sectionIndex = n
            header:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String(sec.token, sec.fallback))
            local icon = getglobal(name .. "HeaderIcon")
            if sec.expanded then
                icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up")
            else
                icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up")
            end
            header:Show()
            getglobal(name .. "Description"):Hide()
            getglobal(name .. "Key1Button"):Hide()
            getglobal(name .. "Key2Button"):Hide()
        end

        -- ── The list repaint (1.12 KeyBindingFrame_Update) ──
        function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local scroll = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrame")
            local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll)
            for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED do
                local name = BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE .. i
                local row = getglobal(name)
                local item = page.items[offset + i]
                if item and item.header then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, item.header)
                    row:Show()
                elseif item then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, item.bind)
                    row:Show()
                else
                    row:Hide()
                end
            end
            FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(page.items),
                BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT)
            -- Our trough follows the bar `FauxScrollFrame_Update` has just shown or hidden.
            BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName())
            BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
        end

        -- The page entry: a rebind or a set switch may have changed the table.
        function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections()
            local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsCharacterRowCheck")
            if GetCurrentBindingSet() == 2 then
                box:SetChecked(1)
            else
                box:SetChecked(nil)
            end
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrameScrollBar"):SetValue(0)
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_Output(text)
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsOutput"):SetText(text)
        end

        -- ── Selection ── while a capsule is selected the window takes every key and the
        -- wheel, as 1.12's keyboard-enabled KeyBindingFrame does (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:73,
        -- :541-543); unarmed it takes neither, so keys and the wheel reach the game.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(command, keyID)
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected = command
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.keyID = keyID
            if BenillaOptionsFrame then
                BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableKeyboard(command ~= nil)
                BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableMouseWheel(command ~= nil)
            end
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
            local unbind = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind")
            if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected then
                unbind:Enable()
            else
                unbind:Disable()
            end
        end

        -- Every search row: a bind from one can unbind a victim shown on another.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
            if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted then
                for name, index in pairs(BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted) do
                    BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index)
                end
                BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey()
            else
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update()
            end
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingButton_OnClick (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:228-258): while armed, a middle,
        -- 4 or 5 click binds that button.
        function BenillaKeyBindingButton_OnClick(button)
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if page.selected then
                if button ~= "LeftButton" and button ~= "RightButton" then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button)
                    return
                end
                if page.selected == this.commandName and page.keyID == this:GetID() then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                else
                    BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID())
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "단축키를 지정할 키를 누르십시오 -> %s"),
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName)))
                end
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID())
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                    BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "단축키를 지정할 키를 누르십시오 -> %s"),
                    BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName)))
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        function BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            SaveBindings(GetCurrentBindingSet())
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_OnKeyDown armed branch (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:140-212), then
        -- the live commit: `button` is a mouse button's or the wheel's name, else the key is
        -- `arg1`, the window's OnKeyDown argument. Unarmed it does nothing: the window takes keys
        -- only while armed, so 1.12's unarmed ESCAPE arm never runs here.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button)
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            if not page.selected then
                return
            end
            if button == "LeftButton" then
                button = "BUTTON1"
            elseif button == "RightButton" then
                button = "BUTTON2"
            elseif button == "MiddleButton" then
                button = "BUTTON3"
            elseif button == "Button4" then
                button = "BUTTON4"
            elseif button == "Button5" then
                button = "BUTTON5"
            end
            local chord
            if button then
                if button == "BUTTON1" or button == "BUTTON2" then
                    return
                end
                chord = button
            else
                chord = arg1
            end
            if chord == "UNKNOWN" or chord == "SHIFT" or chord == "CTRL" or chord == "ALT" then
                return
            end
            if IsShiftKeyDown() then chord = "SHIFT-" .. chord end
            if IsControlKeyDown() then chord = "CTRL-" .. chord end
            if IsAltKeyDown() then chord = "ALT-" .. chord end
            local selected = page.selected
            local oldAction = GetBindingAction(chord)
            if oldAction ~= "" and oldAction ~= selected then
                local k1, k2 = GetBindingKey(oldAction)
                if (not k1 or k1 == chord) and (not k2 or k2 == chord) then
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format(
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR", "|cffff0000%s 기능의 단축키가 해제되었습니다!|r"),
                        BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. oldAction, oldAction)))
                else
                    BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "단축키가 지정되었습니다"))
                end
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "단축키가 지정되었습니다"))
            end
            local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(selected)
            if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end
            if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end
            if page.keyID == 1 then
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key1)
                if key2 then SetBinding(key2, selected) end
            else
                if key1 then SetBinding(key1, selected) end
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key2)
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        -- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_SetBinding, message and all; SetBinding refuses only a non-key.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(key, command, oldKey)
            if not SetBinding(key, command) then
                if oldKey then SetBinding(oldKey, command) end
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String(
                    "KEYBINDINGFRAME_MOUSEWHEEL_ERROR",
                    "누르기와 떼기를 구분하는 동작에는 마우스 휠을 지정할 수 없습니다"))
            end
        end

        -- The list's OnMouseWheel while armed (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:377-387).
        function BenillaKeyBindings_OnMouseWheel(delta)
            if delta > 0 then
                BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELUP")
            else
                BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELDOWN")
            end
        end

        -- 1.12's Unbind Key body, then the live commit.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_Unbind()
            local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage
            local key1, key2 = GetBindingKey(page.selected)
            if key1 then SetBinding(key1) end
            if key2 then SetBinding(key2) end
            if key1 and page.keyID == 1 then
                if key2 then SetBinding(key2, page.selected) end
            else
                if key1 then SetBinding(key1, page.selected) end
            end
            BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
            BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
            BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
            BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible()
        end

        -- ── Character-specific set ── checking saves set 2 at once (LoadBindings(2) falls back
        -- to the account set); unchecking confirms first, as the era does. The accept loads set 1
        -- before saving it, or the character binds would be written into the account set.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_CharacterToggle(box)
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            if box:GetChecked() then
                LoadBindings(2)
                SaveBindings(2)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            else
                box:SetChecked(1)
                StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS")
            end
        end

        -- Our key: Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:10 defines the stock one for its own window.
        StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS"] = {
            text = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS",
                "공통 단축키 설정으로 전환하시겠습니까? 이 캐릭터의 개별 단축키 설정이 모두 영구 삭제됩니다."),
            button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "확인"),
            button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "취소"),
            OnAccept = function()
                LoadBindings(1)
                SaveBindings(1)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            end,
        }
        -- Reset To Default confirms, as the era's does; our string, since 1.12 has none.
        StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_RESET_KEYBINDINGS"] = {
            text = "모든 단축키를 기본 설정으로 초기화하시겠습니까?",
            button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "확인"),
            button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "취소"),
            OnAccept = function()
                PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
                LoadBindings(0)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Commit()
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            end,
        }

        -- ── Search ── a binding's tag is its display name uppercased, as the era's.
        -- A static pool of BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS rows, where the era's results scroll.
        function BenillaKeyBindings_SearchMatches(words)
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do
                local command = GetBinding(i)
                if not BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then
                    local tag = string.upper(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command))
                    local s = BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(tag, words)
                    if s then
                        table.insert(out, { score = s, index = i })
                    end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
    ]]></Script>
</Ui>

<Ui>
    <!--
        The script error log, which 1.12 does not have, so every name carries the `Benilla` prefix;
        the stock `ScriptErrors` dialog shows one message, this keeps the log. Laid out on the
        ClassTrainer panel art as the class trainer lays itself out (Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:214-356
        and :481-513, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:469-474): its rows, its list, its detail under the
        list and its two buttons in the art's sockets. It collects as a 1.12 error-log addon does:
        it wraps the handler `geterrorhandler` holds, the stock `_ERRORMESSAGE`
        (BasicControls.xml:16), which still runs after it. An addon that later calls
        `seterrorhandler` replaces the chain, as in 1.12.
    -->
    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- A pushable above every stock panel's, so a game window opening pushes the log aside.
        UIPanelWindows["BenillaScriptLogFrame"] = { area = "left", pushable = 9, whileDead = 1 }

        -- The class trainer's rows (`CLASS_TRAINER_SKILLS_DISPLAYED`, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:470).
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS = 11
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT = 16
        -- A wrapped row would break the faux kit's fixed rows.
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS = 52

        -- A `seq`, not an index: indices shift when the cap evicts.
        BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil

        -- Distinct messages kept before the oldest is evicted.
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP = 256
        -- Rows oldest first, each { seq, message, count }; `total` is the last `seq` handed out,
        -- kept apart from the row count so an eviction or a clear never renumbers.
        BenillaScriptLog = { rows = {}, total = 0 }

        -- A repeat bumps its row's count and keeps its place.
        function BenillaScriptLog_Record(message)
            if type(message) ~= "string" then message = tostring(message) end
            local log = BenillaScriptLog
            local found = nil
            for i = 1, table.getn(log.rows) do
                if log.rows[i].message == message then found = log.rows[i] end
            end
            if found then
                found.count = found.count + 1
            else
                log.total = log.total + 1
                if table.getn(log.rows) >= BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP then table.remove(log.rows, 1) end
                table.insert(log.rows, { seq = log.total, message = message, count = 1 })
            end
            if BenillaScriptLogFrame and BenillaScriptLogFrame:IsVisible() then
                BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            end
        end

        -- The chain: the log first, guarded so a fault in it cannot stop the stock handler.
        local benillaStockErrorHandler = geterrorhandler()
        seterrorhandler(function(message)
            pcall(BenillaScriptLog_Record, message)
            return benillaStockErrorHandler(message)
        end)

        -- `strsub` counts bytes, so the cut backs up over UTF-8 continuation bytes (0x80..0xBF).
        function BenillaScriptLog_RowText(message)
            local cut = strfind(message, "\n", 1, 1)
            local head = message
            if cut then head = strsub(message, 1, cut - 1) end
            if strlen(head) > BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS then
                local last = BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS - 3
                while last > 0 do
                    local b = strbyte(head, last + 1)
                    if not b or b < 128 or b >= 192 then break end
                    last = last - 1
                end
                head = strsub(head, 1, last) .. "..."
            end
            return head
        end

        function BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            local shown = table.getn(BenillaScriptLog.rows)
            local total = BenillaScriptLog.total

            local summary
            if total == 0 then
                summary = "No problems this session."
            elseif total > shown then
                summary = format("%d problems (%d older not kept)", total, total - shown)
            elseif total == 1 then
                summary = "1 problem"
            else
                summary = format("%d problems", total)
            end
            getglobal("BenillaScriptLogSummary"):SetText(summary)

            local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
            FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, shown, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT)
            BenillaScrollTrough_Follow("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
            local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)

            local selectedRow = nil
            for i = 1, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS do
                local button = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogRow" .. i)
                local index = offset + i
                local row = BenillaScriptLog.rows[index]
                if row then
                    button.seq = row.seq
                    button.message = row.message
                    -- `#12 x1113`: one deduplicated failure that happened 1,113 times.
                    local label = "#" .. row.seq
                    if row.count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. row.count end
                    button.index:SetText(label)
                    button.label:SetText(BenillaScriptLog_RowText(row.message))
                    button:Show()
                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then selectedRow = button end
                else
                    button.seq = nil
                    button.message = nil
                    button:Hide()
                end
            end

            -- Hides when the row scrolls away, as the reference's CraftFrame does.
            local highlight = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogHighlightFrame")
            if selectedRow then
                highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", selectedRow:GetName(), "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
                highlight:Show()
            else
                highlight:Hide()
            end

            BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
        end

        -- The selected message in full, traceback and all, in a box a player can select and copy
        -- from. A text that has not changed is left alone: `SetText` collapses the selection, so a
        -- new error arriving must not undo one about to be copied. A different text takes the
        -- keyboard from the box, as a click on another row does.
        function BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
            local text = ""
            if BenillaScriptLogSelected then
                for _, row in ipairs(BenillaScriptLog.rows) do
                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then
                        text = row.message
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if text == "" then
                text = "Select a row above to read it in full."
            end
            local box = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailText")
            if text ~= box.shown then
                box.shown = text
                box:ClearFocus()
                box:SetText(text)
            end
        end

        -- The box is read-only: a player's edit is undone. The restore's own `SetText` raises
        -- another change, which finds the text equal and stops; `SetText` of an equal text does
        -- nothing. The selection an edit replaced is put back, so Ctrl+C still copies it all.
        function BenillaScriptLogDetail_OnTextChanged()
            local shown = this.shown or ""
            if this:GetText() ~= shown then
                this:SetText(shown)
                this:HighlightText()
            end
            ScrollingEdit_OnTextChanged(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailScroll"))
        end

        function BenillaScriptLogRow_OnClick(button)
            if not button.seq then return end
            if BenillaScriptLogSelected == button.seq then
                BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
            else
                BenillaScriptLogSelected = button.seq
            end
            BenillaScriptLog_Update()
        end

        function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnLoad()
            -- Masks the square icon to the portrait ring.
            SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaScriptLogFramePortrait",
                "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_01")
        end

        -- The list frame's OnVerticalScroll repaints.
        function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta)
            BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame"), delta)
        end

        -- ── Entry points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        function BenillaScriptLog_Toggle()
            local frame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame")
            if frame:IsVisible() then
                HideUIPanel(frame)
            else
                ShowUIPanel(frame)
            end
        end

        -- `/errors clear`: keeps the numbering, so a number never names two failures.
        function BenillaScriptLog_Clear()
            BenillaScriptLog.rows = {}
            BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
            if getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame"):IsVisible() then
                BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            end
            DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("Script log cleared.", 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)
        end
    ]]></Script>

    <!-- One list row: the `#N xCount` column, then the message head. -->
    <Button name="BenillaScriptLogRowTemplate" virtual="true" hidden="true">
        <Size><AbsDimension x="293" y="16"/></Size>
        <Layers>
            <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                <FontString name="$parentIndex" inherits="GameFontNormalSmall" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Size><AbsDimension x="56" y="16"/></Size>
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT" relativePoint="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="4" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                </FontString>
                <FontString name="$parentLabel" inherits="GameFontNormalSmall" justifyH="LEFT">
                    <Size><AbsDimension x="229" y="16"/></Size>
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT" relativePoint="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="62" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                </FontString>
            </Layer>
        </Layers>
        <HighlightTexture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Listbox-Highlight2" alphaMode="ADD"/>
        <Scripts>
            <OnLoad>
                this.index = getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Index")
                this.label = getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label")
            </OnLoad>
            <OnClick>BenillaScriptLogRow_OnClick(this)</OnClick>
        </Scripts>
    </Button>

    <Frame name="BenillaScriptLogFrame" hidden="true">
        <!-- The standard left-slot panel size. No <Anchors>: ShowUIPanel seats it. -->
        <Size><AbsDimension x="384" y="512"/></Size>
        <Layers>
            <Layer level="BACKGROUND">
                <!-- OnLoad masks the square icon, whose corners would show through the ring. -->
                <Texture name="BenillaScriptLogFramePortrait" file="Interface\Icons\INV_Misc_Note_01">
                    <Size><AbsDimension x="60" y="60"/></Size>
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="7" y="-6"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                </Texture>
            </Layer>
            <!-- The ClassTrainer quadrants, the one profession-free set in the 1.12 art. -->
            <Layer level="BORDER">
                <Texture file="Interface\ClassTrainerFrame\UI-ClassTrainer-TopLeft"><Size><AbsDimension x="256" y="256"/></Size><Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT"/></Anchors></Texture>
                <Texture file="Interface\ClassTrainerFrame\UI-ClassTrainer-TopRight"><Size><AbsDimension x="128" y="256"/></Size><Anchors><Anchor point="TOPRIGHT"/></Anchors></Texture>
                <Texture file="Interface\ClassTrainerFrame\UI-ClassTrainer-BotLeft"><Size><AbsDimension x="256" y="256"/></Size><Anchors><Anchor point="BOTTOMLEFT"/></Anchors></Texture>
                <Texture file="Interface\ClassTrainerFrame\UI-ClassTrainer-BotRight"><Size><AbsDimension x="128" y="256"/></Size><Anchors><Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"/></Anchors></Texture>
                <FontString name="BenillaScriptLogTitle" inherits="GameFontNormal" justifyH="CENTER" text="Script Errors">
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="TOP" relativePoint="TOP"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="-17"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                </FontString>
                <FontString name="BenillaScriptLogSummary" inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall" justifyH="LEFT" text="">
                    <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="26" y="-76"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                </FontString>
            </Layer>
        </Layers>
        <Frames>
            <Button name="BenillaScriptLogCloseButton" inherits="UIPanelCloseButton">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-29" y="-8"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>

            <!-- Declared before the rows so their text draws over the glow. -->
            <Frame name="BenillaScriptLogHighlightFrame" hidden="true">
                <Size><AbsDimension x="293" y="16"/></Size>
                <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"/></Anchors>
                <Layers><Layer level="ARTWORK">
                    <Texture file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Listbox-Highlight2">
                        <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT"/><Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"/></Anchors>
                    </Texture>
                </Layer></Layers>
            </Frame>

            <!-- The class trainer's first row (ClassTrainerSkill1, Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:214-222). -->
            <Button name="BenillaScriptLogRow1" inherits="BenillaScriptLogRowTemplate">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="22" y="-100"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
            </Button>

            <Button name="BenillaScriptLogRow3" inherits="BenillaScriptLogRowTemplate"><Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT" relativeTo="BenillaScriptLogRow2" relativePoint="BOTTOMLEFT"/></Anchors></Button>

<Ui>
    <!--
        The script error log, which 1.12 does not have, so every name carries the `Benilla` prefix;
        the stock `ScriptErrors` dialog shows one message, this keeps the log. Laid out on the
        ClassTrainer panel art as the class trainer lays itself out (Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:214-356
        and :481-513, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:469-474): its rows, its list, its detail under the
        list and its two buttons in the art's sockets. It collects as a 1.12 error-log addon does:
        it wraps the handler `geterrorhandler` holds, the stock `_ERRORMESSAGE`
        (BasicControls.xml:16), which still runs after it. An addon that later calls
        `seterrorhandler` replaces the chain, as in 1.12.
    -->
    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- A pushable above every stock panel's, so a game window opening pushes the log aside.
        UIPanelWindows["BenillaScriptLogFrame"] = { area = "left", pushable = 9, whileDead = 1 }

        -- The class trainer's rows (`CLASS_TRAINER_SKILLS_DISPLAYED`, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:470).
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS = 11
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT = 16
        -- A wrapped row would break the faux kit's fixed rows.
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS = 52

        -- A `seq`, not an index: indices shift when the cap evicts.
        BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil

        -- Distinct messages kept before the oldest is evicted.
        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP = 256
        -- Rows oldest first, each { seq, message, count }; `total` is the last `seq` handed out,
        -- kept apart from the row count so an eviction or a clear never renumbers.
        BenillaScriptLog = { rows = {}, total = 0 }

        -- A repeat bumps its row's count and keeps its place.
        function BenillaScriptLog_Record(message)
            if type(message) ~= "string" then message = tostring(message) end
            local log = BenillaScriptLog
            local found = nil
            for i = 1, table.getn(log.rows) do
                if log.rows[i].message == message then found = log.rows[i] end
            end
            if found then
                found.count = found.count + 1
            else
                log.total = log.total + 1
                if table.getn(log.rows) >= BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP then table.remove(log.rows, 1) end
                table.insert(log.rows, { seq = log.total, message = message, count = 1 })
            end
            if BenillaScriptLogFrame and BenillaScriptLogFrame:IsVisible() then
                BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            end
        end

        -- The chain: the log first, guarded so a fault in it cannot stop the stock handler.
        local benillaStockErrorHandler = geterrorhandler()
        seterrorhandler(function(message)
            pcall(BenillaScriptLog_Record, message)
            return benillaStockErrorHandler(message)
        end)

        -- `strsub` counts bytes, so the cut backs up over UTF-8 continuation bytes (0x80..0xBF).
        function BenillaScriptLog_RowText(message)
            local cut = strfind(message, "\n", 1, 1)
            local head = message
            if cut then head = strsub(message, 1, cut - 1) end
            if strlen(head) > BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS then
                local last = BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS - 3
                while last > 0 do
                    local b = strbyte(head, last + 1)
                    if not b or b < 128 or b >= 192 then break end
                    last = last - 1
                end
                head = strsub(head, 1, last) .. "..."
            end
            return head
        end

        function BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            local shown = table.getn(BenillaScriptLog.rows)
            local total = BenillaScriptLog.total

            local summary
            if total == 0 then
                summary = "이번 접속에서 발생한 오류가 없습니다."
            elseif total > shown then
                summary = format("오류 %d개 (이전 오류 %d개는 보관되지 않음)", total, total - shown)
            elseif total == 1 then
                summary = "오류 1개"
            else
                summary = format("오류 %d개", total)
            end
            getglobal("BenillaScriptLogSummary"):SetText(summary)

            local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
            FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, shown, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT)
            BenillaScrollTrough_Follow("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
            local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)

            local selectedRow = nil
            for i = 1, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS do
                local button = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogRow" .. i)
                local index = offset + i
                local row = BenillaScriptLog.rows[index]
                if row then
                    button.seq = row.seq
                    button.message = row.message
                    -- `#12 x1113`: one deduplicated failure that happened 1,113 times.
                    local label = "#" .. row.seq
                    if row.count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. row.count end
                    button.index:SetText(label)
                    button.label:SetText(BenillaScriptLog_RowText(row.message))
                    button:Show()
                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then selectedRow = button end
                else
                    button.seq = nil
                    button.message = nil
                    button:Hide()
                end
            end

            -- Hides when the row scrolls away, as the reference's CraftFrame does.
            local highlight = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogHighlightFrame")
            if selectedRow then
                highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", selectedRow:GetName(), "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
                highlight:Show()
            else
                highlight:Hide()
            end

            BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
        end

        -- The selected message in full, traceback and all, in a box a player can select and copy
        -- from. A text that has not changed is left alone: `SetText` collapses the selection, so a
        -- new error arriving must not undo one about to be copied. A different text takes the
        -- keyboard from the box, as a click on another row does.
        function BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
            local text = ""
            if BenillaScriptLogSelected then
                for _, row in ipairs(BenillaScriptLog.rows) do
                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then
                        text = row.message
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if text == "" then
                text = "전체 내용을 보려면 위에서 항목을 선택하십시오."
            end
            local box = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailText")
            if text ~= box.shown then
                box.shown = text
                box:ClearFocus()
                box:SetText(text)
            end
        end

        -- The box is read-only: a player's edit is undone. The restore's own `SetText` raises
        -- another change, which finds the text equal and stops; `SetText` of an equal text does
        -- nothing. The selection an edit replaced is put back, so Ctrl+C still copies it all.
        function BenillaScriptLogDetail_OnTextChanged()
            local shown = this.shown or ""
            if this:GetText() ~= shown then
                this:SetText(shown)
                this:HighlightText()
            end
            ScrollingEdit_OnTextChanged(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailScroll"))
        end

        function BenillaScriptLogRow_OnClick(button)
            if not button.seq then return end
            if BenillaScriptLogSelected == button.seq then
                BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
            else
                BenillaScriptLogSelected = button.seq
            end
            BenillaScriptLog_Update()
        end

        function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnLoad()
            -- Masks the square icon to the portrait ring.
            SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaScriptLogFramePortrait",
                "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_01")
        end

        -- The list frame's OnVerticalScroll repaints.
        function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta)
            BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame"), delta)
        end

        -- ── Entry points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        function BenillaScriptLog_Toggle()
            local frame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame")
            if frame:IsVisible() then
                HideUIPanel(frame)
            else
                ShowUIPanel(frame)
            end
        end

        -- `/errors clear`: keeps the numbering, so a number never names two failures.
        function BenillaScriptLog_Clear()
            BenillaScriptLog.rows = {}
            BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
            if getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame"):IsVisible() then
                BenillaScriptLog_Update()
            end
            DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("스크립트 기록을 지웠습니다.", 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)
        end
    ]]></Script>
