                                 through OnTextChanged; a click selects it all, so Ctrl+C copies the
                                 error. Not wired: the stock scroll-to-caret (UIPanelTemplates.lua:
                                 314-342), since selecting all leaves the caret at the end and a
                                 click would scroll a long traceback to its bottom. -->
                            <EditBox name="BenillaScriptLogDetailText" multiLine="true" autoFocus="false">
                                <Size><AbsDimension x="296" y="119"/></Size>
                                <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"/></Anchors>
                                <TextInsets><AbsInset left="6" right="20" top="6" bottom="20"/></TextInsets>
                                <Scripts>
                                    <OnTextChanged>BenillaScriptLogDetail_OnTextChanged()</OnTextChanged>
                                    <OnEditFocusGained>this:HighlightText()</OnEditFocusGained>
                                    <OnEscapePressed>this:ClearFocus()</OnEscapePressed>
                                </Scripts>
                                <FontString inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
                            </EditBox>
                        </Frames>
                        <Scripts>
                            <OnMouseUp>BenillaScriptLogDetailText:SetFocus()</OnMouseUp>
                        </Scripts>
                    </Frame>
                </Frames>
            </ScrollFrame>

            <!-- The art's two button sockets, where the class trainer's Train and Exit sit
                 (Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:481-513). -->
            <Button name="BenillaScriptLogClearButton" inherits="UIPanelButtonTemplate" text="지우기">
                <Size><AbsDimension x="80" y="22"/></Size>
                <Anchors><Anchor point="CENTER" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="224" y="-420"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                <Scripts><OnClick>BenillaScriptLog_Clear()</OnClick></Scripts>
            </Button>
            <Button name="BenillaScriptLogCloseBottomButton" inherits="UIPanelButtonTemplate" text="닫기">
                <Size><AbsDimension x="80" y="22"/></Size>
                <Anchors><Anchor point="CENTER" relativePoint="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="305" y="-420"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                <Scripts><OnClick>HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame"))</OnClick></Scripts>
            </Button>
        </Frames>
        <Scripts>
            <OnLoad>BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnLoad()</OnLoad>
            <!-- A spin bubbles up the parent chain; the detail pane's own handler wins there. -->
            <OnMouseWheel>BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnMouseWheel(arg1)</OnMouseWheel>
            <OnShow>BenillaScriptLog_Update()</OnShow>
        </Scripts>
    </Frame>
    <!-- The player's commands, as an addon registers them; after the stock ChatFrame.lua, which
         declares SlashCmdList. -->
    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- Deviation: 1.12 has no `/reload` (later clients added it; 1.12 reloads through
        -- `/console reloadui`); kept so a player can reload the interface after toggling addons.
        SLASH_BENILLA_RELOAD1 = "/reload"
        SlashCmdList["BENILLA_RELOAD"] = function()
            ReloadUI()
        end

        -- `/errors` toggles the log and `/errors clear` empties it; `/err` is the short form.
        SLASH_BENILLA_ERRORS1 = "/errors"
        SLASH_BENILLA_ERRORS2 = "/err"
        SlashCmdList["BENILLA_ERRORS"] = function(msg)
            local arg = string.lower((string.gsub(msg or "", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")))
            if arg == "clear" then
                BenillaScriptLog_Clear()
            else
                BenillaScriptLog_Toggle()
            end
        end
    ]]></Script>
</Ui>

<Ui>
    <!--
        The Options window the game menu opens. Deviation: the 1.15 era client's single settings
        window replaces the 1.12 four-panel family, which is much worse to use; the 1.12 frames
        still load, hidden, for addons. Every art byte is 1.12-native or a colour fill, so era
        names below cite geometry only. Hiding discards pending edits and Apply commits outright.
        A slider shows the 1.12 range; an out-of-range value displays clamped, not written back.
    -->

    <!-- The era's 14 and 20 white fonts, outside Fonts.xml's 1.12 set; MasterFont's shadow. -->
    <Font name="BenillaOptionsFontHighlightMedium" font="Fonts\FRIZQT__.TTF" virtual="true">
        <Shadow>
            <Offset><AbsDimension x="1" y="-1"/></Offset>
            <Color r="0" g="0" b="0"/>
        </Shadow>
        <FontHeight><AbsValue val="14"/></FontHeight>
        <Color r="1.0" g="1.0" b="1.0"/>
    </Font>
    <Font name="BenillaOptionsFontHighlightHuge" font="Fonts\FRIZQT__.TTF" virtual="true">
        <Shadow>
            <Offset><AbsDimension x="1" y="-1"/></Offset>
            <Color r="0" g="0" b="0"/>
        </Shadow>
        <FontHeight><AbsValue val="20"/></FontHeight>
        <Color r="1.0" g="1.0" b="1.0"/>
    </Font>

    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- UIOptionsFrame.xml loads first and owns the uvars; each row captures its default at
        -- OnLoad.
        -- Deviation: AUTO_QUEST_WATCH is the string "1". 1.12 assigns the number 1 (l.122) but
        -- every consumer compares against "1" (QuestLogFrame.lua:64/68); 1 ~= "1" in Lua 5.0.
        AUTO_QUEST_WATCH = "1"
        RegisterForSave("AUTO_QUEST_WATCH")

        -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:370-376: Blizzard_CombatText is LoadOnDemand, so the master loads it.
        function BenillaCombatText_UpdateOrLoad()
            if ( SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT == "1" ) then
                UIParentLoadAddOn("Blizzard_CombatText")
            end
            if ( CombatText_UpdateDisplayedMessages ) then
                CombatText_UpdateDisplayedMessages()
            end
        end
        -- The Remove Chat Hover Delay row's applyFunc (UIOptionsFrame.lua:216).
        function BenillaChatFrame_ApplyMouseOverDelay()
            if SetChatMouseOverDelay then -- nil in a VM loaded without the chat files
                SetChatMouseOverDelay(REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY)
            end
        end

        -- Show Tutorials' setter (UIOptionsFrame.lua:318-327); there is no tutorial CVar. The `~=`
        -- guard is the reference's: re-ticking an on row must not re-arm dismissed tutorials.
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_SetTutorialsEnabled(value)
            if ( tonumber(value) ~= TutorialsEnabled() ) then
                if ( value == "1" ) then
                    ResetTutorials()
                    TutorialFrameCheckButton:SetChecked(1)
                else
                    ClearTutorials()
                end
                TutorialFrame_HideAllAlerts()
            end
        end

        -- The two plate rows' store: FrameXML's own NAMEPLATES_ON/FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON, the number 1
        -- or nil (a "0" would be truthy), applied through the verbs as the bindings do.
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_GetEnemyPlates()
            return NAMEPLATES_ON
        end
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_SetEnemyPlates(value)
            if ( value == "1" ) then
                NAMEPLATES_ON = 1
                ShowNameplates()
            else
                NAMEPLATES_ON = nil
                HideNameplates()
            end
        end
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_GetFriendlyPlates()
            return FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON
        end
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_SetFriendlyPlates(value)
            if ( value == "1" ) then
                FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON = 1
                ShowFriendNameplates()
            else
                FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON = nil
                HideFriendNameplates()
            end
        end

        -- The category tree in list order; keys are the row name suffixes.
        BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS = {
            "Controls", "Interface", "ActionBars", "Combat", "Chat", "Keybindings", "Nameplates",
            "Graphics", "Audio",
        }

        -- The era UIParent draws smaller than our 768-unit canvas; a chosen value, not the
        -- reference's.
        BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE = 0.78

        function BenillaOptionsFrame_UpdateScale()
            -- The era panel's checkFit: it also shrinks to fit the screen.
            local k = BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE
            local wFit = GetScreenWidth() / 940
            local hFit = GetScreenHeight() / 744
            if wFit < k then k = wFit end
            if hFit < k then k = hFit end
            BenillaOptionsFrame:SetScale(k)
        end

        -- The era tab width, label + 40, measured after OnShow sets the scale.
        function BenillaOptionsTab_FitWidth(tab)
            tab:SetWidth(getglobal(tab:GetName() .. "Text"):GetStringWidth() + 40)
        end

        -- The wash at the era atlas size, in the 1.14 hover steel-blue.
        function BenillaOptionsCategoryRow_OnLoad(row, key, label)
            row.categoryKey = key
            row.pageTitle = label
            row:SetText(label)
            local bg = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Bg")
            bg:SetWidth(187)
            bg:SetHeight(21)
            bg:SetVertexColor(0.196, 0.388, 0.8)
        end

        -- 1.14's OptionsList_SelectButton. SetText("") ends a search and re-enters here.
        function BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(key)
            BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory = key
            if BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:GetText() ~= "" then
                BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:SetText("")
                return -- the restore re-entered with this key and finished
            end
            for _, k in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do
                local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k)
                local bg = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k .. "Bg")
                if k == key then
                    bg:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 0)
                    bg:Show()
                    row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontHighlight")
                    BenillaOptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText(row.pageTitle)
                else
                    bg:SetVertexColor(0.196, 0.388, 0.8)
                    bg:Hide()
                    row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontNormal")
                end
            end
            for k in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                local body = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k)
                if k == key then body:Show() else body:Hide() end
            end
            -- A category switch starts at the top, as the era ScrollBox does per category.
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0)
            -- Leaving Keybindings disarms a pending capture, which must never outlive the page.
            local kb = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindings")
            if key == "Keybindings" then
                kb:Show()
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
                BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Show()
                BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Enable()
            else
                kb:Hide()
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Hide()
                if BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then
                    BenillaOptionsPage_Refresh(key)
                    BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Enable()
                else
                    BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Disable()
                end
            end
        end

        -- ── Search: the era SettingsPanel search ──
        -- Tags are labels uppercased, matched by plain substring and scored by matched length.
        -- Results are the live rows, so writes work mid-search.

        function BenillaOptionsSearch_Words(text)
            local up = string.upper(text)
            local words = { up }
            for w in string.gfind(up, "([^, ]+)") do
                table.insert(words, w)
            end
            return words
        end

        -- The era's MatchesSearchTags score, with a plain find.
        function BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(tag, words)
            for _, w in ipairs(words) do
                local first, last = string.find(tag, w, 1, true)
                if first then return last - first end
            end
            return nil
        end

        function BenillaOptionsSearch_FindMatches(text)
            local words = BenillaOptionsSearch_Words(text)
            local buckets, scores = {}, {}
            for _, key in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do
                if BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then
                    for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do
                        local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey)
                        local s = BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(row.searchTag, words)
                        if s then
                            if not buckets[s] then
                                buckets[s] = {}
                                table.insert(scores, s)
                            end
                            table.insert(buckets[s], { key = key, rkey = rkey })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- Keybinding matches join the buckets; their rkey is the binding index.
            for _, m in ipairs(BenillaKeyBindings_SearchMatches(words)) do
                if not buckets[m.score] then
                    buckets[m.score] = {}
                    table.insert(scores, m.score)
                end
                table.insert(buckets[m.score], { key = "Keybindings", rkey = m.index })
            end
            table.sort(scores, function(a, b) return a > b end)
            local groups, order = {}, {}
            for _, s in ipairs(scores) do
                for _, m in ipairs(buckets[s]) do
                    if not groups[m.key] then
                        groups[m.key] = {}
                        table.insert(order, m.key)
                    end
                    table.insert(groups[m.key], m.rkey)
                end
            end
            return order, groups
        end

        -- ── The page scroll ──
        -- Only frames hung off the body's top are measured, so the size converges.
        function BenillaOptionsScroll_ContentBottom()
            local bottom = nil
            local function take(name)
                local f = getglobal(name)
                if f and f:IsVisible() then
                    local b = f:GetBottom()
                    if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end
                end
            end
            for _, key in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do
                if BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then
                    take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key)
                    for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do
                        take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey)
                    end
                end
            end
            take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings")
            for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do
                take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i)
            end
            return bottom
        end

        -- From OnUpdate, off the previous frame's rects; SetWidth and SetHeight invalidate layout.
        function BenillaOptionsScroll_Fit()
            local sf = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll
            local body = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody
            local fw, fh = sf:GetWidth(), sf:GetHeight()
            if not fw or fw <= 0 or not fh or fh <= 0 then return end
            if math.abs(body:GetWidth() - fw) >= 0.5 then body:SetWidth(fw) end
            local h = fh
            local top, bottom = body:GetTop(), BenillaOptionsScroll_ContentBottom()
            if top and bottom then
                local content = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD
                if content > h then h = content end
            end
            if math.abs(body:GetHeight() - h) >= 0.5 then
                body:SetHeight(h)
                sf:UpdateScrollChildRect()
            end
        end

        -- The era SettingsList layout: the head at (10,-12), each next at (0,-9), as in the XML.
        function BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev)
            local f = getglobal(name)
            f:ClearAllPoints()
            if prev then
                f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", prev, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -9)
                f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", prev, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, -9)
            else
                f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPLEFT", 10, -12)
                f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPRIGHT", -20, -12)
            end
        end

        -- Back on the XML chain after a search; a test holds the two equal.
        function BenillaOptionsPage_Layout(key)
            local prev = nil
            for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do
                local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey
                BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev)
                getglobal(name):Show()
                prev = name
            end
        end

        -- The title and no-match strings are ours: the era's are not in its UI source.
        function BenillaOptionsSearch_Display(text)
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0)
            for k in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k):Show()
                for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[k]) do
                    getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k .. rkey):Hide()
                end
                getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide()
            end
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindings"):Hide()
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide()
            for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do
                getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide()
            end
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil
            BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Hide()
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText("Search Results")
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Hide()

            local order, groups = BenillaOptionsSearch_FindMatches(text)
            if table.getn(order) == 0 then
                BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Show()
                return
            end
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide()
            local prev = nil
            for _, key in ipairs(order) do
                local head = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key
                BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(head, prev)
                getglobal(head):Show()
                prev = head
                if key == "Keybindings" then
                    BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = {}
                    local shown = 0
                    for _, index in ipairs(groups[key]) do
                        if shown < BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS then
                            shown = shown + 1
                            local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. shown
                            BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index)
                            BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev)
                            getglobal(name):Show()
                            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted[name] = index
                            prev = name
                        end
                    end
                else
                    local placed = {}
                    for _, rkey in ipairs(groups[key]) do
                        local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey)
                        if row.parentRow and not placed[row.parentRow] then
                            placed[row.parentRow] = 1
                            local pname = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. row.parentRow
                            BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(pname, prev)
                            getglobal(pname):Show()
                            prev = pname
                        end
                        if not placed[rkey] then
                            placed[rkey] = 1
                            local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey
                            BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev)
                            row:Show()
                            prev = name
                        end
                    end
                    BenillaOptionsPage_Refresh(key)
                end
            end
        end

        function BenillaOptionsSearch_Restore()
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0)
            for k in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                BenillaOptionsPage_Layout(k)
                getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide()
            end
            for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do
                getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide()
            end
            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide()
            BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide()
            BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Show()
            BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory or "Controls")
        end

        function BenillaOptionsSearch_OnTextChanged(text)
            if text == BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText then return end
            local had = BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText and BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText ~= ""
            BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText = text
            if text == "" then
                if had then BenillaOptionsSearch_Restore() end
            else
                BenillaOptionsSearch_Display(text)
            end
        end

        -- ── The setting pages: 1.12 rows in the era Settings grammar ──
        -- Descriptions 1.12 lacks take a BENILLA_ prefix.
        BENILLA_TOOLTIP_RENDER_SCALE =
            "Draws the 3D world at a fraction of the window's resolution, or larger than it. "
            .. "The interface is unaffected at any setting.\n\n"
            .. "Below 100% trades sharpness for frame rate; above 100% is supersampling, which "
            .. "smooths edges at the cost of frame rate. Applies when you click Apply."

        -- 1.12 has no such checkbox.
        BENILLA_TOOLTIP_BACKGROUND_SOUND =
            "Keeps the game's sound playing while you are working in another window.\n\n"
            .. "With this off, switching away silences the game and switching back restores it. "
            .. "Sounds keep running while they are silenced, so a long one may have finished by "
            .. "the time you return."

        -- 1.12's WINDOWED_MODE text describes a checkbox and exclusive-mode gamma.
        BENILLA_TOOLTIP_DISPLAY_MODE =
            "Windowed (Fullscreen) fills the screen with a borderless window; Windowed runs in "
            .. "an ordinary one.\n\n"
            .. "There is no exclusive fullscreen mode. WoW itself removed one in 8.0.1, and "
            .. "modern Classic offers these same two."

        -- 1.12's GAMMA text points at gray-bar art this page does not have.
        BENILLA_TOOLTIP_BRIGHTNESS =
            "Lightens or darkens the whole picture — nights, caves and interiors are what it is "
            .. "for.\n\n"
            .. "This is the same correction 1.12 applied through the display's own gamma ramp, "
            .. "which it could only do in exclusive fullscreen. benilla applies it to the "
            .. "finished image instead, so it works in both display modes."

        BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS = {
            -- The era Controls order first; the rest follow their 1.12 box's columns.
            Controls = {
                "RowStickyTarget", "RowAssistAttack", "RowClearAFK",
                "RowBlockTrades", "RowAutoSelfCast",
                "RowAutoLoot", "RowInvertMouse", "RowMouseSpeed", "RowClickToMove",
                "RowCameraFollowStyle", "RowFollowTerrain", "RowHeadBob",
                "RowAutoFollowSpeed", "RowWaterCollision", "RowSmartPivot",
                "RowMouseLookSpeed", "RowMaxCameraDistance",
            },
            Audio = {
                "RowEnableAll", "RowMaster", "RowSound", "RowMusic", "RowAmbience",
                "RowEnableMusic", "RowEnableAmbience", "RowEnableErrorSpeech",
                "RowBackgroundSound",
            },
            Graphics = {
                "RowUiScale", "RowFarclip", "RowWorldDetail", "RowSpellDetail", "RowBrightness",
                "RowWeatherDensity",
                "RowDisplayMode", "RowVerticalSync", "RowRenderScale",
            },
            -- Guild Names is a child of Player Names (UIOptionsFrame.lua:703-709).
            Nameplates = {
                "RowEnemyPlates", "RowFriendlyPlates",
                "RowPlayerNames", "RowGuildNames", "RowNpcNames", "RowOwnName",
            },
            -- 1.12's Display box by column, then Help; target-of-target sits under Status Text.
            Interface = {
                "RowEnhancedTooltips", "RowStatusText", "RowTargetOfTarget", "RowTargetOfTargetMode",
                "RowShowCloak", "RowShowHelm",
                "RowInstantQuestText", "RowBuffDurations", "RowAutoQuestWatch",
                "RowProfanityFilter",
                "RowShowTutorials", "RowTipOfTheDay", "RowNewbieTips",
            },
            -- 1.12's chat box (UIOptionsFrame.xml:751-840). Not shipped: Simple Chat, which needs
            -- FCF_Set_SimpleChat's re-layout, Lock Chat Settings and Guild Recruitment.
            Chat = {
                "RowGuildMemberAlert", "RowRemoveChatDelay", "RowChatBubbles", "RowLootSpam",
                "RowPartyChatBubbles", "RowSpamFilter",
            },
            -- Deviation: the bar toggles precede the lock, which 1.12's box leads with, so what is
            -- on screen reads first.
            ActionBars = {
                "RowMultiBar1", "RowMultiBar2", "RowMultiBar3", "RowMultiBar4",
                "RowAlwaysShowMultibars", "RowLockActionBar",
            },
            -- The combat-text box in its anchor-chain order.
            Combat = {
                "RowCombatText", "RowFloatMode", "RowLowHealthMana", "RowAuras", "RowAuraFade",
                "RowCombatState", "RowDodgeParryMiss", "RowResistances", "RowReputation",
                "RowReactives", "RowFriendlyNames", "RowComboPoints", "RowEnergyGains",
                "RowHonorGained",
                -- Under their own master (UIOptionsFrame.lua:710-716).
                "RowShowDamage", "RowPeriodicDamage", "RowPetDamage",
            },
        }

        -- `tip` is a GlobalStrings key, resolved at hover as UIOptionsFrame.lua:265 does.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_OnLoad(row, cvar, label, tip, child)
            row.cvar = cvar
            row.tip = tip
            row.searchTag = string.upper(label)
            -- BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled's disabled font must keep the child size.
            row.child = child
            local l = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Label")
            l:SetText(label)
            if child then
                l:SetFontObject("GameFontNormalSmall")
                l:ClearAllPoints()
                l:SetPoint("LEFT", row:GetName(), "LEFT", 52, 0)
                l:SetPoint("RIGHT", row:GetName(), "CENTER", -85, 0)
            end
        end

        -- ── The row's store ──
        -- 1.12's `cvar`, `uvar` or `func`/`setFunc` (UIOptionsFrame.lua:230-377), all strings. Keep
        -- BenillaOptionsRow_HasStore in BenillaOptionsRow_Set's order.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_HasStore(row)
            return row.uvar or row.setFunc or row.cvar
        end

        function BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row)
            if row.uvar then return getglobal(row.uvar) end
            if row.getFunc then
                -- OptionsFrame.lua:110/135, formatted like the slider's write so strings compare
                -- equal.
                if row.numeric then
                    return (string.gsub(string.format("%.2f", row.getFunc()), "%.?0+$", ""))
                end
                if row.getFunc() then return "1" else return "0" end
            end
            return GetCVar(row.cvar)
        end

        -- A uvar row applies on the click; `cvarEvent` is CVAR_UPDATE's arg1.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, value)
            if row.uvar then
                setglobal(row.uvar, value)
                -- Looked up when applied: most definers load after this file.
                local apply = row.applyFunc
                if type(apply) == "string" then apply = getglobal(apply) end
                if apply then apply() end
                return
            end
            -- The "1"/"0" string, as UIOptionsFrame.lua:291-297.
            if row.setFunc then
                -- A number, as OptionsFrame.lua:206-226.
                if row.numeric then
                    row.setFunc(tonumber(value))
                else
                    row.setFunc(value)
                end
                return
            end
            SetCVar(row.cvar, value, row.cvarEvent)
            BenillaOptionsRow_WritePartner(row, value)
        end

        -- UIOptionsFrame_Save's partner writes: Pet Melee Damage also writes PetSpellDamage
        -- (l.334-336); the camera speeds write their pitch twin at yaw/4 and yaw/2 (l.351-356).
        function BenillaOptionsRow_WritePartner(row, value)
            if not row.partner then return end
            local v = value
            if row.partner.scale then
                v = string.gsub(
                    string.format("%.2f", tonumber(value) * row.partner.scale), "%.?0+$", "")
            end
            SetCVar(row.partner.cvar, v)
        end

        -- A uvar's default is captured at OnLoad, before the saved-variables chunk runs.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_Default(row)
            if row.uvar then return row.udefault end
            if row.getFunc then return row.fdefault end
            return GetCVarDefault(row.cvar)
        end

        -- BenillaOptionsRow_OnLoad's signature with the global's name in the cvar seat.
        function BenillaOptionsGlobalRow_OnLoad(row, uvar, label, tip, child)
            BenillaOptionsRow_OnLoad(row, nil, label, tip, child)
            row.uvar = uvar
            row.udefault = getglobal(uvar)
        end

        -- Stated, as UIOptionsFrame_SetDefaults hand-writes it (l.631-634).
        function BenillaOptionsFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child)
            BenillaOptionsRow_OnLoad(row, nil, label, tip, child)
            row.getFunc = getFunc
            row.setFunc = setFunc
            row.fdefault = default
        end

        -- `default` is still a string, since rows compare strings.
        function BenillaOptionsNumFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child)
            BenillaOptionsFuncRow_OnLoad(row, getFunc, setFunc, default, label, tip, child)
            row.numeric = 1
        end

        -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:193-227 re-applies saved uvars, so this window has no load ladder.

        -- OptionsFrameSliders is the stock table (OptionsFrame.lua:24-34), which addons write.
        -- Holes at 4, 5 and 7, so the OnShow loop uses the pairs form: ipairs would stop at 3.
        BENILLA_GRAPHICS_SLIDER_ROWS = {
            "RowUiScale", "RowFarclip", "RowWorldDetail",
            [6] = "RowBrightness", [8] = "RowSpellDetail", [9] = "RowWeatherDensity",
        }

        -- SetMinMaxValues re-clamps and fires OnValueChanged, which must not write back.
        function BenillaOptionsSliderRow_Setup(row, min, max, step, fmt, stops)
            local slider = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "ControlSlider")
            row.fmt = fmt
            -- Kept for the "travel" readout, a share of the row's own range.
            row.minv, row.maxv = min, max
            -- Deviation: a named ladder reads out its stop; 1.12's slider labels only its ends, and
            -- a bare index would mean nothing to a player.
            row.stops = stops
            row.refreshing = 1
            slider:SetMinMaxValues(min, max)
            slider:SetValueStep(step)
            row.refreshing = nil
        end

        -- ── The dropdown rows: the 1.12 UIDropDownMenu kit ──
        function BenillaOptionsDropdownRow_Setup(row, entries)
            row.entries = entries
            local dd = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Dropdown")
            UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(180, dd)
            UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(dd, BenillaOptionsDropdownRow_InitMenu)
            -- The capsule's button steals hover from the row, so it carries the row wash too.
            local btn = getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button")
            btn:SetScript("OnEnter", function() BenillaOptionsRow_Hover(this:GetParent():GetParent(), 1) end)
            btn:SetScript("OnLeave", function() BenillaOptionsRow_Hover(this:GetParent():GetParent(), nil) end)
        end

        function BenillaOptionsDropdownRow_InitMenu()
            local dd = getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_INIT_MENU)
            local row = dd:GetParent()
            for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do
                local info = {}
                info.text = e.text
                info.value = e.value
                info.func = BenillaOptionsDropdownEntry_OnClick
                UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info)
            end
        end

        -- `this` is the list button; the kit closes the list and plays the click.
        function BenillaOptionsDropdownEntry_OnClick()
            local dd = UIDropDownMenu_GetCurrentDropDown()
            local row = dd:GetParent()
            BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, this.value)
            BenillaOptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row)
        end

        -- A field, not SetSelectedValue, whose Refresh walks the shared DropDownList1. An off-grid
        -- value shows the nearest entry.
        function BenillaOptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row)
            local dd = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Dropdown")
            local v = BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row)
            local match
            for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do
                -- `alt`: a stored "3" shows as Never, where the nearest value would show Always.
                if e.value == v or (e.alt ~= nil and e.alt == v) then match = e end
            end
            if not match and tonumber(v) then
                local best
                for _, e in ipairs(row.entries) do
                    local d = tonumber(e.value) and math.abs(tonumber(e.value) - tonumber(v))
                    if d and (not best or d < best) then
                        best = d
                        match = e
                    end
                end
            end
            if match then
                dd.selectedValue = match.value
                UIDropDownMenu_SetText(match.text, dd)
                -- As UIOptionsFrameCameraDropDown_OnClick retargets OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA<id>.
                if match.tip then row.tip = match.tip end
            else
                dd.selectedValue = v
                UIDropDownMenu_SetText(v, dd)
            end
        end

        function BenillaOptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value)
            if row.fmt == "raw" then
                return string.format("%d", math.floor(value + 0.5))
            end
            -- The clamp guards a short stops table.
            if row.stops then
                local i = math.floor(value + 0.5) + 1
                if i < 1 then i = 1 end
                if i > table.getn(row.stops) then i = table.getn(row.stops) end
                return row.stops[i]
            end
            -- "travel": the thumb's share of the groove. Brightness stores the reference's
            -- `1 - gamma` (-0.5 to +0.5, default 0) and reads 0 to 100% with the default at 50.
            if row.fmt == "travel" and row.minv and row.maxv and row.maxv > row.minv then
                return string.format("%d%%",
                    math.floor((value - row.minv) / (row.maxv - row.minv) * 100 + 0.5))
            end
            -- "yards": cameraDistanceMaxFactor over the 15 yd base.
            if row.fmt == "yards" then
                return string.format("%d yd", math.floor(value * 15 + 0.5))
            end
            return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5))
        end

        -- Crossing controls does not blink: OnLeave fires before OnEnter within a move.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_Hover(row, on)
            local hover = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Hover")
            if on then
                hover:Show()
                BenillaOptionsRow_ShowTooltip(row)
            else
                hover:Hide()
                GameTooltip:Hide()
            end
        end

        -- 1.12's per-option string alone in gold (OptionsFrameTemplates.xml:52-64).
        function BenillaOptionsRow_ShowTooltip(row)
            local text = row.tip and getglobal(row.tip)
            if text then
                GameTooltip:SetOwner(getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Tip"), "ANCHOR_RIGHT", -10, 0)
                GameTooltip:SetText(text, nil, nil, nil, nil, 1)
            else
                -- Deviation: 1.12 returns early here; a mute row hides the last plate, so a
                -- neighbour's text cannot stand when its OnLeave was missed.
                GameTooltip:Hide()
            end
        end

        function BenillaOptionsCheckbox_OnClick(box)
            local row = box:GetParent()
            local checked = box:GetChecked()
            -- The 1.12 panels disagree: the interface panel plays CheckBoxOn when checked
            -- (OptionsFrame.lua:509-515), the sound panel CheckBoxOff; Audio rows carry soundQuirk.
            local kitOn = checked
            if row.soundQuirk then kitOn = not kitOn end
            if kitOn then
                PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            else
                PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff")
            end
            -- An inverted row (Sticky Targeting, Disable Spam Filter) writes the opposite.
            local on = checked
            if row.invert then on = not on end
            if on then
                BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, "1")
            else
                BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, "0")
            end
            BenillaOptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory)
        end

        function BenillaOptionsSlider_OnValueChanged(slider, value)
            local control = slider:GetParent()
            local row = control:GetParent()
            if not row.refreshing then
                -- Snaps to the grid from the minimum (farclip's is 177+n*60); a refresh sets it
                -- raw.
                local step = slider:GetValueStep()
                if step and step > 0 then
                    local minv = slider:GetMinMaxValues()
                    local snapped = minv + math.floor((value - minv) / step + 0.5) * step
                    if math.abs(snapped - value) > 0.00001 then
                        slider:SetValue(snapped) -- re-enters once with the snapped value
                        return
                    end
                    value = snapped -- the clean grid number, not the f32-rounded echo
                end
            end
            getglobal(control:GetName() .. "Value"):SetText(BenillaOptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value))
            if BenillaOptionsRow_HasStore(row) and not row.refreshing then
                -- Trailing zeros stripped, so a value at its default stays out of the config file.
                local str = string.gsub(string.format("%.2f", value), "%.?0+$", "")
                if row.deferred then
                    -- Stored on Apply; a pending equal to the committed value is dropped.
                    if str == BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row) then
                        row.pending = nil
                    else
                        row.pending = str
                    end
                    BenillaOptionsApply_Update()
                else
                    BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, str)
                end
            end
        end

        function BenillaOptionsPage_Refresh(key)
            local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key
            for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do
                local row = getglobal(base .. rkey)
                local box = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "Check")
                if box then
                    -- "0" unchecks; an inverted row checks on "0".
                    if row.invert then
                        local checked
                        if BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row) == "0" then checked = 1 end
                        box:SetChecked(checked)
                    else
                        box:SetChecked(BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row))
                    end
                elseif row.entries then
                    BenillaOptionsDropdown_ShowValue(row)
                else
                    local slider = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlSlider")
                    row.refreshing = 1
                    -- A staged value shows first, as the era's GetValue returns it.
                    slider:SetValue(tonumber(row.pending or BenillaOptionsRow_Get(row) or "0") or 0)
                    row.refreshing = nil
                    -- SetValue fires only on a change, so the readout is written here.
                    getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlValue"):SetText(
                        BenillaOptionsRow_FormatValue(row, slider:GetValue()))
                end
            end
            BenillaOptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key)
            BenillaOptionsApply_Update()
        end

        -- Each page's dependency rules, the 1.12 panel's own.
        function BenillaOptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key)
            if key == "Combat" then
                -- Combo Points is for rogues and druids only.
                local on = SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT ~= "0"
                local _, class = UnitClass("player")
                class = class and string.upper(class)
                local combo = class == "ROGUE" or class == "DRUID"
                -- The damage-number trio is not under this master.
                local damage = {
                    RowShowDamage = 1, RowPeriodicDamage = 1, RowPetDamage = 1,
                }
                for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS.Combat) do
                    if rkey ~= "RowCombatText" and not damage[rkey] then
                        local live = on
                        if rkey == "RowComboPoints" and not combo then live = nil end
                        BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(
                            getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombat" .. rkey), live)
                    end
                end
                -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:710-716: Show Target Damage off greys Periodic and Pet Damage.
                local dmg = GetCVar("CombatDamage") ~= "0"
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombatRowPeriodicDamage, dmg)
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyCombatRowPetDamage, dmg)
                return
            end
            if key == "Controls" then
                -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:717-721: dead while the style is Never, "0" or a stray "3".
                local style = GetCVar("cameraSmoothStyle")
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyControlsRowAutoFollowSpeed,
                    style ~= "0" and style ~= "3")
                return
            end
            if key == "Nameplates" then
                -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:703-709: Player Names off greys Player Guild Names.
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNameplatesRowGuildNames,
                    GetCVar("UnitNamePlayer") ~= "0")
                return
            end
            if key == "Interface" then
                -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:697-701: the mode is dead while its switch is off.
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyInterfaceRowTargetOfTargetMode,
                    SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET ~= "0")
                return
            end
            if key == "ActionBars" then
                -- UIOptionsFrame.lua:722-726: Right ActionBar 2 needs Right ActionBar.
                BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyActionBarsRowMultiBar4,
                    SHOW_MULTI_ACTIONBAR_3)
                return
            end
            if key ~= "Audio" then return end
            -- SoundOptionsFrame_UpdateDependencies; Enable Music stays live, as in 1.12.
            local on = GetCVar("MasterSoundEffects") ~= "0"
            for _, row in {"RowEnableAmbience", "RowEnableErrorSpeech"} do
                local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyAudio"..row.."Check")
                local label = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyAudio"..row.."Label")
                if on then
                    box:Enable()
                    label:SetFontObject("GameFontNormal")
                else
                    box:Disable()
                    label:SetFontObject("GameFontDisable")
                end
            end
        end

        -- As OptionsFrame_DisableDropDown; 1.12 has no UIDropDownMenu_DisableDropDown.
        function BenillaOptionsRow_SetEnabled(row, on)
            local name = row:GetName()
            local box = getglobal(name .. "Check")
            local dd = getglobal(name .. "Dropdown")
            -- As OptionsFrame_DisableSlider (l.481-486); a press on the track would seat the value.
            local sl = getglobal(name .. "ControlSlider")
            if box then
                if on then box:Enable() else box:Disable() end
            elseif sl then
                local thumb = getglobal(name .. "ControlSliderThumb")
                local value = getglobal(name .. "ControlValue")
                if on then
                    sl:EnableMouse(true)
                    thumb:Show()
                    value:SetTextColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g,
                        NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b)
                else
                    sl:EnableMouse(false)
                    thumb:Hide()
                    value:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b)
                end
            elseif dd then
                local text = getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Text")
                if on then
                    getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button"):Enable()
                    text:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g,
                        HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b)
                else
                    getglobal(dd:GetName() .. "Button"):Disable()
                    text:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b)
                end
            end
            local label = getglobal(name .. "Label")
            if on then
                label:SetFontObject(row.child and "GameFontNormalSmall" or "GameFontNormal")
            else
                label:SetFontObject(row.child and "GameFontDisableSmall" or "GameFontDisable")
            end
        end

        -- Pending edits dropped.
        function BenillaOptionsPage_Defaults(key)
            local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key
            for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do
                local row = getglobal(base .. rkey)
                row.pending = nil
                BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, BenillaOptionsRow_Default(row))
            end
            BenillaOptionsPage_Refresh(key)
        end

        -- ── The Apply flow ──
        -- Pending edits survive a category switch; hiding discards them.

        function BenillaOptionsApply_Update()
            local pending
            for key, rows in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key
                for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do
                    if getglobal(base .. rkey).pending then pending = 1 end
                end
            end
            if pending then
                BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Enable()
                BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Show()
            else
                BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Disable()
                BenillaOptionsFrameApplyButton:Hide()
            end
        end

        function BenillaOptionsPage_Apply()
            for key, rows in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key
                for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do
                    local row = getglobal(base .. rkey)
                    if row.pending then
                        BenillaOptionsRow_Set(row, row.pending)
                        row.pending = nil
                    end
                end
            end
            BenillaOptionsApply_Update()
        end

        function BenillaOptionsPage_DiscardPending()
            for key, rows in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do
                local base = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key
                for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do
                    getglobal(base .. rkey).pending = nil
                end
            end
            BenillaOptionsApply_Update()
        end
    ]]></Script>

                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Audio")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadGraphics" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Graphics"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Graphics")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadCombat" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Combat"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Combat")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadActionBars" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "ActionBars"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Action Bars")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadInterface" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Interface"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Interface")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadChat" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Chat"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Chat")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadNameplates" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Nameplates"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Nameplates")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <Button name="$parentSearchHeadKeybindings" inherits="BenillaOptionsSearchHeadTemplate">
                                    <Scripts><OnLoad>
                                        this.categoryKey = "Keybindings"
                                        getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText("Keybindings")
                                    </OnLoad></Scripts>
                                </Button>
                                <!-- BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS (8) frames. -->
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch1" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch2" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch3" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch4" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch5" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch6" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch7" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                                <Frame name="$parentKeybindSearch8" inherits="BenillaKeyBindingRowTemplate" hidden="true"/>
                            </Frames>
                            </Frame>
                            <!-- Inset 21/20 so the trough, which hangs 21 above and 20 below the
                                 bar, lands flush. -->
                            <Slider name="$parentBar" inherits="BenillaScrollBarTemplate" hidden="true">
                                <Anchors>
                                    <Anchor point="TOPRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-10" y="-21"/></Offset></Anchor>
                                    <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-10" y="20"/></Offset></Anchor>
                                </Anchors>
                                <Scripts><OnValueChanged>BenillaScrollBar_OnValueChanged(this, arg1)</OnValueChanged></Scripts>
                            </Slider>
                        </Frames>
                    </ScrollFrame>
                </Frames>
            </Frame>

            <!-- The search box: the era geometry in the 1.12 Common-Input-Border; no magnifier,
                 which has no 1.12 art, so the text inset is 5, not 16. -->
            <EditBox name="$parentSearchBox" autoFocus="false" letters="64">
                <Size><AbsDimension x="350" y="22"/></Size>
                <Anchors>
                    <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT" relativeTo="$parentContainer" relativePoint="TOPRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="4" y="20"/></Offset></Anchor>
                </Anchors>
                <Layers>
                    <Layer level="BACKGROUND">
                        <Texture name="$parentBorderLeft" file="Interface\Common\Common-Input-Border">
                            <Size><AbsDimension x="8" y="20"/></Size>
                            <Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-5" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                            <TexCoords left="0" right="0.0625" top="0" bottom="0.625"/>
                        </Texture>
                        <Texture name="$parentBorderRight" file="Interface\Common\Common-Input-Border">
                            <Size><AbsDimension x="8" y="20"/></Size>
                            <Anchors><Anchor point="RIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="0" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                            <TexCoords left="0.9375" right="1" top="0" bottom="0.625"/>
                        </Texture>
                        <Texture name="$parentBorderMiddle" file="Interface\Common\Common-Input-Border">
                            <Size><AbsDimension y="20"/></Size>
                            <Anchors>
                                <Anchor point="LEFT" relativeTo="$parentBorderLeft" relativePoint="RIGHT"/>
                                <Anchor point="RIGHT" relativeTo="$parentBorderRight" relativePoint="LEFT"/>
                            </Anchors>
                            <TexCoords left="0.0625" right="0.9375" top="0" bottom="0.625"/>
                        </Texture>
                    </Layer>
                    <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                        <!-- The placeholder (the era instructions label, tinted 0.35). -->
                        <FontString name="$parentInstructions" inherits="GameFontDisableSmall" justifyH="LEFT" text="Search">
                            <Anchors>
                                <Anchor point="TOPLEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="5" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor>
                                <Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-20" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor>
                            </Anchors>
                            <Color r="0.35" g="0.35" b="0.35"/>
                        </FontString>
                    </Layer>
                </Layers>
                <Frames>
                    <!-- The clear button (era ClearButtonMixin), half alpha until hovered. -->
                    <Button name="$parentClearButton" hidden="true">
                        <Size><AbsDimension x="17" y="17"/></Size>
                        <Anchors><Anchor point="RIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-3" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                        <Layers>
                            <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                                <Texture name="$parentIcon" file="Interface\Buttons\UI-Panel-MinimizeButton-Up" alpha="0.5">
                                    <Size><AbsDimension x="17" y="17"/></Size>
                                    <Anchors><Anchor point="CENTER"/></Anchors>
                                </Texture>
                            </Layer>
                        </Layers>
                        <Scripts>
                            <OnClick>
                                BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:SetText("")
                                BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:ClearFocus()
                            </OnClick>
                            <OnEnter>getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetAlpha(1.0)</OnEnter>
                            <OnLeave>getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetAlpha(0.5)</OnLeave>
                        </Scripts>
                    </Button>
                </Frames>
                <TextInsets><AbsInset left="5" right="20" top="0" bottom="0"/></TextInsets>
                <Scripts>
                    <OnTextChanged>
                        if this:GetText() == "" then
                            BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBoxInstructions:Show()
                            BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBoxClearButton:Hide()
                        else
                            BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBoxInstructions:Hide()
                            BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBoxClearButton:Show()
                        end
                        BenillaOptionsSearch_OnTextChanged(this:GetText())
                    </OnTextChanged>
                    <OnEscapePressed>this:ClearFocus()</OnEscapePressed>
                </Scripts>
                <FontString inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"/>
            </EditBox>

            <!-- ── Close: no corner X; the red button and ESC close the window ── -->
            <Button name="$parentCloseButton" inherits="BenillaOptionsRedButtonTemplate" text="Close">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-16" y="16"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                <Scripts>
                    <OnClick>
                        PlaySound("igMainMenuClose")
                        HideUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame)
                    </OnClick>
                </Scripts>
            </Button>
            <!-- The era Apply, shown with a pending edit. -->
            <Button name="$parentApplyButton" inherits="BenillaOptionsRedButtonTemplate" text="Apply" hidden="true">
                <Anchors><Anchor point="RIGHT" relativeTo="$parentCloseButton" relativePoint="LEFT"><Offset><AbsDimension x="-2" y="0"/></Offset></Anchor></Anchors>
                <Scripts>
                    <OnLoad>this:Disable()</OnLoad>
                    <OnClick>BenillaOptionsPage_Apply()</OnClick>
                </Scripts>
            </Button>
        </Frames>
        <Scripts>
            <!-- Controls by default; selection persists and the scale re-fits, as the era's. -->
            <OnShow>
                BenillaOptionsFrame_UpdateScale()
                BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(this.selectedCategory or "Controls")
                if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end
            </OnShow>
            <!-- The Keybindings capture, 1.12's KeyBindingFrame OnClick and OnKeyDown
                 (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:538-543) and its list's wheel (:377-387): keyboard and
                 wheel stay off until a capsule is selected (BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected). -->
            <OnLoad>
                this:EnableKeyboard(false)
                this:EnableMouseWheel(false)
            </OnLoad>
            <OnKeyDown>BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown()</OnKeyDown>
            <OnMouseUp>BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(arg1)</OnMouseUp>
            <OnMouseWheel>BenillaKeyBindings_OnMouseWheel(arg1)</OnMouseWheel>
            <!-- Hiding ends a search, discards pending edits, and disarms a bind capture. -->
            <OnHide>
                BenillaOptionsFrameSearchBox:SetText("")
                BenillaOptionsPage_DiscardPending()
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end
            </OnHide>
        </Scripts>
    </Frame>
    <!-- BenillaOptionsFrame, because the stock OptionsFrame.xml owns `OptionsFrame`. Chat-tab hover
         (FloatingChatFrame.lua:842/860) reads the hidden UIOptionsFrame, so it works while this
         window, which does not cover the chat, is open. -->
    <Script><![CDATA[
        -- The reference's OptionsFrame row (UIParent.lua:16): the centre slot, openable while dead.
        UIPanelWindows["BenillaOptionsFrame"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 }
    ]]></Script>
</Ui>
